provenance.instrument: Warrington Township Zoning Ordinance, Chapter 370 Zoning (Ord. No. 2021-O-04, 8-24-2021), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 header on 2026-11-14: 'Includes legislation through 08-11-2026.' Table 300 carries amendments to Ord. No. 2026-O-01 (3-10-2026), which also added 370-820 on secondary kitchens. New Laws list Ord. No. 2026-O-05 'Zoning Amendment' (2026-09-08), not yet folded in. Only a PDF, not read. A local meeting summary (July 14, 2026) says a Pickertown Road rezoning was tabled to the September 8 meeting, so it may be that map change. Not confirmed.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: 'Includes legislation through 08-11-2026.' New Laws: Ord. No. 2026-O-05 (2026-09-08, Zoning Amendment), not codified.
checks: The code's ADU is the 'multigenerational apartment' (Use H1): a special exception (Zoning Hearing Board) in RA, R1, R2, R2-I, R3, MR and EV. Not allowed in any other district (Table 300, 370-304A)
Only for people related to the owner by birth, marriage or law (adoption, fostering, guardianship). No rent or fee. The owner certifies who lives there by affidavit each year (370-305H(1))
The house must be owner-occupied and served by public water and public sewer (370-305H(1)(a)[1])
Inside the main house only, with internal access and the same entrance and exits as the house. The house keeps one front entrance (370-305H(1)(a)[4], [5])
At most 25% of the house or 800 sq ft, whichever is less. One per lot (370-305H(1)(a)[2], [6])
The lot must meet the district's minimum lot area for a single-family detached house (370-305H(1)(a)[7])
One parking space beyond what the house needs. A Bucks County Department of Health permit first (370-305H(1)(a)[8], [9])
Since 3-10-2026 a second kitchen may not sit in a separate suite with its own living and bathroom space, nor open directly to the outside (370-820)
A two-family detached dwelling (duplex) is a separate use, by right only in MR and EV (Table 300)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Warrington Township (warringtontownship.org). Read on eCode360 in a browser, one page at a time. Table 300 read from screenshots of the print view. District dimensional rules read only for R1 (370-409). RA, R2, R2-I, R3, MR and EV district pages were not opened. Off-street parking (370-602) not opened.

term.note: 'H1, Multigenerational apartment: a dwelling unit contained within an owner-occupied, single-family residence, subordinate in size to the principal dwelling, for which no rent or other fee is chargeable, and which is used exclusively as living quarters by a person or persons related by birth or marriage, or determined by law (adoption, fostering, or guardianship) to the owner(s) as permitted by special exception.'

status.note: Relatives of the owner only, no rent. By special exception in RA, R1, R2, R2-I, R3, MR and EV.

status_outside.note: 'If a use is not shown as a permitted, conditional, or special exception in a district on Table 300, then said use is prohibited in that district.'

path.note: Table 300 marks H1 'S' (special exception) in RA, R1, R2, R2-I, R3, MR and EV.

fallback_path.note: A unit that fails 370-305H(1) needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Two-family detached dwelling (duplex)
value.conditions: Use B4. A building with two units. District area rules for MR and EV were not read.
value.note: Listed as P in MR and EV. Whether an existing house may be converted to a duplex was not checked.

building_types.note: 'single-family residence'. The house keeps 'the appearance of a detached dwelling'.

existing_structure_only.note: Inside the main house. The code does not say the house must already exist.

requires_conforming_lot.note: 'The lot shall conform to the minimum lot area requirement for Use B1, Single-family detached dwelling, in the applicable zoning district.'

value.condition: Only people related to the owner by birth, marriage, adoption, fostering or guardianship. No rent or other fee. Yearly affidavit of who lives there.
The house must be served by public sewer.
The house must be served by public water.
Inside the main house with internal access, sharing the house's entrance and exits. The house keeps the look of a detached dwelling with one front entrance.
A Bucks County Department of Health permit before the zoning permit.

A second kitchen outside an approved apartment may not be in a separate suite with living and bathroom space, may not open directly to the outside, and may sit only on the main living level or a lower level.

types_allowed.note: 'A multigenerational apartment shall be contained within the main dwelling'.

max_sqft.note: 'not more than 25% of the principal residence or 800 square feet, whichever is less.'

max_height_ft.note: Inside the house. No ADU height.

occupancy.value: People related to the owner by birth, marriage, adoption, fostering or guardianship. No rent or fee.

max_adus.note: 'Not more than one multigenerational apartment shall be permitted per lot.'

short_term_rental_banned.note: No rent or other fee may be charged, so any rental is barred.

spaces_required.note: 'one additional off-street parking space shall be required for each multigenerational apartment in addition to the single-family detached dwelling requirement.'

new_connection_required.note: Public water and sewer required. No rule on a separate connection.

min_lot_sqft.note: 40,000 sq ft. Three acres for a single-family house without public utilities.

setback_front_ft.note: 35 ft or half the street width, whichever is greater.

utility_rows.note: 'Use B1, Single-family detached dwelling (without public utilities): three acres.' Stored for the case with neither service.
